A subcommittee was scheduled to meet before the committee talks to town employees about their space needs.
The next full committee meeting was set for March 2.
A member's space-allocation spreadsheet, built on a square-footage-per-employee standard, was compared department by department against the earlier Taylor and Burns study.

why_it_matters: This concerns a likely debt-excluded capital project for Ritter and Town Hall, which would appear as a separate line on a future tax bill rather than inside the town's operating budget.
The committee is steering toward renovation over new construction before any formal vote or public comment on that choice has occurred.
Town employees whose departments were sized in the spreadsheet have not yet been consulted on their space needs.
